chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: Taft Jordan and Frankie Fairfax's Philadelphia band
summary: Taft Jordan was an all-around trumpeter and clown with Chick Webb; Jackson thinks he and Dizzy played in Frankie Fairfax's Philadelphia band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: We haven't mentioned Taft Jordan yet.

Taft Jordan. Taft Jordan was -- to me he was a great all-around trumpet player. Taft could, he played wonderful solos. He was a good musician. He was a clown, too. And he was with Chick quite a while and he played a lot of --
Yeah, Chick Webb. -- and he played a lot of wonderful solos in that band and he stayed in that band for quite a while, you know.
You got any more trumpet players down there you want to -- ?

I think Taft came from Philadelphia, too, I think. I think he was in that band of Frankie Fairfax. In fact, the trumpet section, I think Taft was there and I think Dizzy was there. And, you know, Jimmy Hamilton, you know, used to play trumpet with Frankie Fairfax, the great clarinetist that was with Ellington, he played trumpet with Frankie Fairfax.
Frankie Fairfax had a band, huh?
In Philadelphia, a colored band there.
Uh-huh. We haven't mentioned him, Frankie Fairfax.
Uh-huh, yeah. Yeah, he had a good band around Philadelphia. I didn't really know the personnel.
Philadelphia itself contributed a lot of great musicians to us.
